bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 135 (Tuesday, August 5, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. KRISHNAMOORTHI:
H.R. 4890.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
U.S. Constitution Section 1, Article 8
[Page H3682]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on House Administration, and in addition to the Committees on Oversight and Government Reform, and the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Ending Trading and Holdings in Congressional Stocks (ETHICS) Act
